title: Study of Aortic Root Reimplantation Procedure
brief_summary: Authors hypothesize that aortic root reimplantation procedure is superior over standard aortic valve reimplantation procedure in the incidence of aortic valve replacement.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aortic insufficiency 2+
* Ascending aorta or aortic root of greater than 4.5 cm (\> 4.0 cm in Marfan syndrome)
* Good conditions of aortic cusps

Exclusion Criteria:

* Aortic annulus more than 32 mm
* Aortic cusps destruction
* Critical aortic cusps elongation
* Aortic root dissection
